title: HPLC Analysis of tRNA-Derived Nucleosides
author: Xingxing Chen
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: Synthetic complete yeast growth medium (Formedium, catalog number: CSC
1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.4 (Santa Cruz, catalog number: SC-
1 M Tris-HCl, pH 8.3 (Fisher Scientific, catalog number: T
Qubit RNA Broad Range kit (Thermo Fisher, catalog number: Q10210 )
Bacterial alkaline phosphatase (BAP) (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number: P
1 M sodium acetate, pH 5.0 (Thermo Fisher, catalog number: J60964.AK)
NH 4 H 2 PO 4 solution (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number:

steps.title: Make 0.9% NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9 g NaCl in 1 L nuclease‑free water; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Make 10 mM ZnCl₂ solution
steps.instruction: Combine 100 µL of 0.1 M ZnCl₂ with 900 µL nuclease‑free water to make 1 L of 10 mM ZnCl₂; store at –20 °C (stable ≥5 yr).

steps.title: Prepare DE52 binding buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5.844 g NaCl in 900 mL nuclease‑free water, add 100 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.4 (final 0.1 M Tris‑HCl, 0.1 M NaCl); bring to 1 L, store at RT (stable ≥1 yr).

steps.title: Prepare DE52 solution
steps.instruction: Mix 100 g DE52 with 300 mL DE52 binding buffer (0.33 g/mL); store at 4 °C (stable ≥6 mo).

steps.title: Prepare tRNA elution buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve 58.44 g NaCl in 900 mL nuclease‑free water, add 100 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.4 (final 0.1 M Tris‑HCl, 1 M NaCl); store at RT (stable ≥1 yr).

steps.title: Make Nuclease P1 solution
steps.instruction: Add one vial (>250 U) Nuclease P1 to 970 µL nuclease‑free water and 30 µL 1 M sodium acetate pH 5.0; final volume 1 mL; store at –20 °C (stable ≥1 yr).

steps.title: Make HPLC solvent A
steps.instruction: Combine 10 mL 1 M NH₄H₂PO₄, 25 mL methanol, 965 mL Milli‑Q water; adjust pH to 5.3 with NH₄OH and H₃PO₄; make up to 1 L.

steps.title: Make HPLC solvent B
steps.instruction: Combine 10 mL 1 M NH₄H₂PO₄, 200 mL methanol, 790 mL Milli‑Q water; adjust pH to 5.1 with NH₄OH and H₃PO₄; make up to 1 L.

steps.title: Make HPLC solvent C
steps.instruction: Combine 10 mL 1 M NH₄H₂PO₄, 350 mL acetonitrile, 640 mL Milli‑Q water; make up to 1 L.

steps.title: Harvest yeast cells
steps.instruction: Grow Saccharomyces cerevisiae in synthetic complete medium to OD₆₀₀ = 1; collect 100 units (100 mL) in 50 mL centrifuge tubes; centrifuge 1,000 × g, 3 min, RT; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cell pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 3 mL 0.9 % NaCl; centrifuge 1,000 × g, 3 min, RT; discard supernatant.

steps.title: First phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 8 mL water‑saturated phenol; vortex at 1,200 rpm, 30 min, RT.

steps.title: Add chloroform and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL chloroform; vortex at 1,200 rpm, 15 min, RT; centrifuge 12,000 × g, 20 min, 4 °C.

steps.title: Second phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer aqueous phase to a 50 mL tube; add 4 mL water‑saturated phenol; vortex 1,200 rpm, 15 min, RT; centrifuge 12,000 × g, 20 min, 4 °C.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Collect aqueous phase, add 2.5 volumes ethanol, invert three times; incubate at –80 °C for 3 h (or –20 °C overnight).

steps.title: Pellet RNA and resuspend
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 12,000 × g, 20 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant; dissolve RNA pellet in 5 mL DE52 binding buffer.

steps.title: Pack DE52 column
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL mixed DE52 solution to a polypropylene column; allow flow by gravity ~5 min at RT.

steps.title: Load RNA onto DE52 column
steps.instruction: Apply the RNA solution to the DE52 column; let flow by gravity at RT.

steps.title: Wash DE52 column twice
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL DE52 binding buffer, wait 5 min; repeat once more.

steps.title: Elute tRNA
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL tRNA elution buffer; collect eluate in a 15 mL tube; repeat elution by re‑applying eluate to the column for higher yield.

steps.title: Precipitate tRNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL isopropanol to the eluate; invert three times; incubate –20 °C ≥3 h.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70 % EtOH
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 12,000 × g, 20 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant; resuspend pellet in 1 mL 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Final ethanol wash and pellet
steps.instruction: Transfer suspension to a 1.5 mL tube; centrifuge 16,000 × g, 5 min, 4 °C; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend purified tRNA
steps.instruction: Dissolve pellet in 50 µL nuclease‑free water; quantify with Qubit RNA Broad Range kit (≈200 µg expected); store at –80 °C ≤1 week or proceed to digestion.

steps.title: Nuclease P1 digestion
steps.instruction: In a tube combine 50 µg tRNA, 5 µL 10 mM ZnCl₂, 5 µL Nuclease P1 solution, 10 µL nuclease‑free water to 50 µL total; incubate 37 °C, 16 h.

steps.title: BAP dephosphorylation
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL 0.5 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.3 and 4 µL bacterial alkaline phosphatase (BAP) to the 50 µL P1 digest; incubate 37 °C, 2 h. Samples are then ready for HPLC.

steps.title: Set up HPLC system
steps.instruction: Place solvent tubes A, B, C into the corresponding HPLC solvent positions (tube D unused); turn on separation module and PDA detector; wet‑prime at 4 mL/min for 4 min; turn on degas; open Empower 3 software; program gradient as per Table 1 (steps 1‑10 with specified times, flow 1 mL/min, %A‑%D); set auto‑injection volume to 60 µL and run time to 140 min per sample.

substeps.instruction: Load solvents A, B, C into the HPLC.
Set injection volume 60 µL, run time 140 min.

steps.title: Load samples and run HPLC
steps.instruction: Transfer each digested tRNA to a 2 mL HPLC sample tube with insert and cap; update the injection list starting with nuclease‑free water then DMSO for column cleaning; inject samples and run the method.
